newsitem.title: USA: JCPenney names brand development chief.
newsitem.headline: JCPenney names brand development chief.

text.p: J.C. Penney Co Inc said directors elected J. Raymond Pierce president of brand development and promoted several other officers effective February 1.

Pierce, now president of JCPenney's men's division, will fill a new position responsible for brand development, quality assurance, and sourcing for the development of proprietary-brand strategies and brand positioning.
Jack Fleischer, divisional vice president, director of merchandising in men's, was elected president of the men's division, succeeding Pierce.
The company also said Nick B. King, divisional vice president, director of merchandising, home and leisure division, was elected president, women's accessories division.

Ann Gravseth, merchandise manager for cosmetics, accessories, and handbags in women's accessories, was elected divisional vice president, director of merchandising, women's accessories division, reporting to King.
Steve F. Raish, director of coordination for stores, was elected divisional vice president, director of merchandising, home and leisure division, JCPenny said.
Chuck Foughty, catalog women's merchandising director, was elected divisional vice president and director of merchandising, women's apparel division.
Cathy J. Mills, vice president, director of company communications, was elected divisional vice president, director of merchandising, women's apparel division.
Anne Seymour, director of target marketing, was elected vice president, director of company communications, succeeding Mills. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
